title: Surface water microbiome response to pyrogenic carbon after a wildland–urban interface fire
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,510-521
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00803D, Paper
Lyssa Morgan, Allison Tilzey, Maya El-Ajouz, Jialin Dong, Cameron Daley, Christopher I. Olivares
Fires in the wildland–urban interface (WUI) introduce pyrogenic organic contaminants to surface waters, but their impacts on microbial dynamics have not been evaluated.
